events.summary:
...Observed flooding changed from Minor to Moderate severity and
increased in duration for the following rivers in Minnesota...

Cedar River near Lansing affecting Mower County.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Minnesota...

Cedar River at Austin affecting Mower County.

.The heaviest rainfall in the Cedar River Basin fell across the
Lansing area, where 2 to 5 inches of rain fell in that sub-basin.
With Lansing already cresting lower than the original forecast, have
lowered the downstream forecasts at Austin and Charles City
accordingly.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Cedar River at Austin.

* WHEN...Until late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, Serious flooding is likely.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 3:00 PM CDT Saturday the stage was 14.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 15.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this afternoon to a crest of 19.5 feet just after midnight
tonight. It will then fall below flood stage tomorrow afternoon.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

At 425 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from South Bloomfield to 6 miles south of New Holland to
near Greenfield, moving east at 35 mph.

rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

unsecured objects. Hail may cause minor damage to
vegetation. Visibility will be poor and hydroplaning is
possible.

Kingston, Williamsport, Bainbridge, New Holland, Logan Elm Village,

weather.gov/iln and submit your report via social media, when you can
do so safely.
